# Fixtures

Golden trace bundles in this directory were generated by the Python
pipeline on 2026-11-02 (`scripts/generate_graphs.py --speaker "KEF R3"
--mversion asr --force` and the Genelec 8351A Princeton equivalent)
and are consumed by `tests/parity_real_data.rs`:

- `kef-r3-asr-cea2034.bundle.json`, `kef-r3-asr-on-axis.bundle.json`
- `genelec-8351a-princeton-cea2034.bundle.json`

Regenerate them with the Python commands above (output lands in
`dist-private/speakers/<speaker>/<origin>/<version>/traces/`) only
when the Python implementation intentionally changes; a diff against
these files is the parity signal. Measurement inputs stay in place:

- Input: `datas/measurements/KEF R3/asr/` (Klippel `SPL Horizontal.txt` /
  `SPL Vertical.txt`)
- Python oracle: `dist-private/speakers/KEF R3/ASR/asr/CEA2034.json` and
  `dist-private/speakers/KEF R3/ASR/asr/traces/CEA2034.json`

Compare generated trace bundles against the oracle bundle trace by
trace; max absolute difference must stay within one quantization step
(0.01 dB) plus interpolation slack on the 1024-point grid.
- PEQ oracle: `datas/eq/KEF R3/iir-autoeq.txt` (Python APO excerpt in
  `tests/apo_roundtrip.rs`); header scores 6.50 -> 7.09. Rust scoring
  of the same PEQ gives 6.39 -> 7.01; biquad response vs Python
  `peq_spl` matches exactly (see /Volumes/home_tmp/tmp/compare_peq_spl.py).
